about_the_game:
A major update is coming soon.
The Secret Story is evolving into a new version: The Secret Story 1996.

The Secret Story 1996 is a reimagined narrative horror experience set in 1996, where mystery, atmosphere, and psychological tension come together in a darker and more immersive form.

This new version redevelops the original game with a stronger narrative presentation, improved visuals, a deeper atmosphere, new gameplay systems, and more story-driven mechanics designed to create a more memorable experience from beginning to end.

Step into a story shaped by unease, hidden truths, and the feeling that something is never quite right. In this reworked version, the world of The Secret Story returns with a new identity, a new tone, and a new level of intensity.

Features

  • A reimagined story set in 1996
    Experience the world of The Secret Story in a newly reworked setting with a darker and more memorable narrative direction.

  • Branching story paths
    Encounter a more varied narrative experience with different story developments throughout the game.

  • Your choices matter
    The decisions you make can affect the direction of the story and lead to different outcomes.

  • Improved visuals and atmosphere
    Redesigned presentation, stronger environmental mood, and upgraded visual quality create a more immersive horror experience.

  • New gameplay systems
    Discover updated mechanics and interactions designed to make the experience more engaging and alive.

  • A refreshed narrative experience
    The story has been reworked to deliver deeper emotional tension, stronger mystery, and a more cohesive experience.

  • 3 language support
    Play the game in English, Thai, or Chinese.

A Note from the Developer

This project is being developed entirely by one solo developer.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. Development has taken time because every part of the game — from design and story direction to gameplay improvements and presentation — is being handled with great care by a single creator.

A major update is on the way, and this is only the beginning.

If you are interested in the future of this project, please Wishlist The Secret Story 1996 to follow upcoming updates.

And if you choose to purchase the game and support its development, it truly helps a lot. Your support makes it possible for this project to keep growing and becoming the experience it is meant to be.

Thank you for being part of the journey.

  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050 , AMD Radeon RX560
